_about: Club Pass perks (docs/specs/club-pass.md §4): the 20 perks on /club-pass, in board order. plan: fan (Fan Club), fan+ (Fan Club, with more for Sub Club), sub (Sub Club only). soon: not built yet (it says Coming soon). head: *word* is the accent word. facts: exactly three; <b> is the only markup. scene: one of the page's scene drawings (scripts/club-pass/scenes.ts). serviceId: the Service Hub manifest it belongs to. passes (optional): the spread's status line for each pass (visitor, fan, sub: [bold line, line]) when the plan's default lines would be wrong, e.g. Boomertang's No. 1 is free to a visitor. Checked by scripts/check-club-pass.js.

perks.label: Backstage
perks.head: Get *backstage.*
perks.dek: Some streams never go to Twitch or YouTube. Backstage streams and after-shows play right here on the site, for members only.
facts: Backstage streams on the site, members only
Studio time each week: watch the YouTube series being recorded, chat on the breaks (coming soon)

perks.label: Game votes
perks.head: *You* pick the games.
perks.dek: Every week the schedule opens to a vote. Suggest a horror game, vote for the ones you want, and watch the week fill up.
facts: Suggest any game from the Game Vault

perks.label: Sub Club stream
perks.head: One night a month, *just us.*
perks.dek: Once a month, Boomer streams for Sub Club only: a smaller room, where chat gets more of his attention.
facts: Plays on the site, like Backstage

perks.label: Chat Games
perks.head: Don't just watch. *Play.*
perks.dek: Chat Games turn the stream into a game show. Ask a question, put Boomer in the Hot Seat, pick a side, call what happens next.
facts: Would You Rather: pick a side, see the split
Predictions: call it, earn XP if you're right

perks.label: Badge drops
perks.head: Blink and it's *gone.*
perks.dek: During a stream a badge can drop at any moment. A gold banner lights up across the site, the fuse starts burning, and whoever claims it in time keeps it for good.
facts: Claim from the gold banner on any page
Badges like Jump Scare Witness and Boss Fight Believer
Some drops are a draw: one winner

perks.label: Contests and drawings
perks.head: Check in. *Win stuff.*
perks.dek: Drawings and contests run during streams, and only members who are checked into the stream can win. Show up, check in, and your name goes in the hat.
facts: Check in to the stream to be eligible
Sub Club gets extra Sub Club drawings (planned)
perks.pull: You have to be there to win.

perks.label: Night Shift
perks.head: Every night has a *mission.*
perks.dek: Night Shift runs in seasons: daily and weekly tasks, a story that unlocks chapter by chapter, and a streak that keeps you coming back.
facts: Sub Club adds Sub Club campaigns and a third saver

perks.label: Boom Arcade
perks.head: Horror puzzles, *made here.*
perks.dek: The Boom Arcade's point-and-click horror puzzle games are being built for members, with boards and badges. Members vote on what gets built next.
perks.pull: Insert coin. Don't look behind you.

perks.label: boomgames.tv
perks.head: A horror library, *for Sub Club.*
perks.dek: boomgames.tv is the plan: a whole library of horror games for Sub Club. It gets built once the Arcade and the community grow enough to earn it.
facts: A horror game library for Sub Club
Built as the Arcade and the community grow
Earn the Arcade Regular badge for early access to the first game

perks.label: Tech Stack
perks.head: See how the *scares* get made.
perks.dek: Tech Stack shows the whole setup. Members get the deep cuts: what every cable does, how the mixer is routed, and how the setup changed over time.
facts: Pull the plug: see what goes dark

perks.label: Creator Climb
perks.head: Watch the *climb.*
perks.dek: Creator Climb tracks follower growth on every platform. Members see every reading, the month reports, the records and the pace toward the goals.

perks.label: Goal Tracker
perks.head: Help write the *comeback.*
perks.dek: The Goal Tracker lays out the plan for The Game Awards 2027, level by level, and shows exactly how you can help.
facts: How you can help at every step

perks.label: Numbers note
perks.head: The *real* numbers.
perks.dek: Once a month, a short note from Boomer on how the channel is really doing: what worked, what didn't, and what's next.
facts: What it means for the road

perks.label: Boomertang
perks.head: Read *Boomertang.*
perks.dek: Boomertang is Boomer's horror gaming magazine: one issue a month, page by page, with the maps, the guides, the speedruns and Chat's Verdict. Each issue stays alive, with new editions when the games change.
facts: No. 1 is free for everyone, and so is any issue made public
Sub Club reads the newest issue first

visitor: So is any issue made public. Join free for the back issues.
fan: Every back issue. Sub Club reads the newest issue first.
sub: The newest issue the day it's out, and every back issue.

perks.label: Rate and suggest
perks.head: Your vote *changes the site.*
perks.dek: Rate every page and feature, suggest ideas in Feature Lab, and report bugs in Bug Zapper. This site gets built with you.
facts: Rate pages: Not for me, Like it, Love it
Report bugs and watch them get zapped
perks.pull: Built with you, not just for you.

perks.label: Trophy case
perks.head: Wear what you *earned.*
perks.dek: Your trophy case sits on your profile. Pin the badges you're proudest of, and let them do the talking.
facts: Sub Club pins 6, with an animated frame
Badges, XP and your level are yours for good

perks.label: Name in the credits
perks.head: Your *name* in the credits.
perks.dek: Sub Club members are named in the credits of Building Boomertanger, the YouTube series about this site and the road to the awards.
facts: For as long as you're in Sub Club

perks.label: Text alerts
perks.head: Never miss the *scream.*
perks.dek: Sub Club members 18 and older can get a text the moment Boomer goes live.
facts: Choose what you get and when
18 and older, with a verified phone

perks.label: Merch shop
perks.head: Members-only *merch.*
perks.dek: The shop is for members only: you need a pass just to browse. Sub Club gets 10% off everything for as long as you're in.
facts: Members only: sign in to browse and buy
Sub Club gets early access to new drops

perks.label: Your account
perks.head: Your pass, *your way.*
perks.dek: Your account page shows your pass, your Twitch link, and later the gifts you've sent and every receipt.
